description: Stage-2 power/timing bonus failure and timer-expiry variant (ticket #130 / F58): identical to sf-win-06 through Gen match win and 0x41a02 entry at 24854, then replaces the 25027 HP press with a 5-frame p1_right hold at 25115 (perturbing 0xff8e4b in the random generator so 0x41cbc..0x41cee gauge-zero reset and random-phase jump select phase 1 when timer 3 expires at 25306), lets timer 3 expire at 25306 with no punch pressed (exercising 0x41570 clr.w D2 and 0x41d48..0x41d4e wind-up sleeps in phase 1), and runs the failure sequence 0x41eda..0x41f5c into 0x3efc4 stage_step at 25760. Continuous checkpoints 24853..=25764.
